dedupe_keys.name: speedtest like measurements in 3g 4g networks the monroe experience

description: The MONROE project deposits mobile-broadband speedtest-like traces collected in four countries during September and October 2016. The provider describes synchronized experiments every three hours on stationary nodes: a single-thread HTTP download of a 40 MB object, Tstat passive flow observations on client and server, and modem status metadata. Zenodo lists three public ZIPs for client logs, server logs and device-modem metadata under CC BY 4.0. These linked views could help calibrate mobile-network throughput or latency simulations and compare access-radio conditions with end-to-end performance. They are historical 3G and 4G measurements, not a modern mobile-coverage service. The page does not identify all four countries or explain the exact join keys and trace schema outside the archives. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this MONROE speedtest package. The ZIPs were not downloaded, so trace matching, completeness and measured speed distributions remain unverified.
